title: How to debug a phone you don’t own: match the chip, rent the twin from Samsung
author: TheSkyIsMyCeiling
selftext:
I'm not a graphics programmer. I built a mobile basketball game with Claude Code, and on launch night a player sent a screenshot: his character had black cuts across the body. Nobody else had it. Our test phones looked fine.

What we did, step by step:

1. Find the phone. The game logs basic device info, so we got his model: a Tecno Spark 30 Pro. Not a phone we could buy that night.

2. Look at what's inside it, not the brand. GPU bugs usually live in the driver, and the driver ships with the chip. His phone runs a MediaTek MT6789 (Mali-G57 GPU).

3. Find the twin. Samsung has a free Remote Test Lab: real Galaxy phones you can rent for a while and control from your computer. We first tried a Galaxy with the same GPU but a different chip, and it was clean. Then we found a Galaxy A15 with the exact same chip, and the bug showed up right away.

4. Make the bug measurable. Claude wrote a tiny detector: draw the same character 4 times and compare the pixels. On a healthy phone they're identical. On the A15 they weren't, so the driver was doing something random.

5. Fix and verify on the twin. The cause was one line in the shader that picks a bone using an index the driver handled badly. We swapped it for a version with fixed indices: 0 bad frames out of 18 on the A15. Same look on every other device, same speed.



Pushed the fix that night. The player wrote back the next day saying it looked good now.

The tip, if you're making mobile games with AI: when a bug only happens on a phone you don't have, search for its chip, find the Samsung with the same chip in Remote Test Lab, and let the AI debug on that one. The pieces that made it work for us: the AI knowing the codebase well enough to suspect the shader, having device info from real players, and a farm of real phones we could match by chip.



The game is El Draft: Carrera, a basketball career game you play match by match, in English, Spanish and Portuguese: [https://eldraftgame.com/carrera](https://eldraftgame.com/carrera)
